subject: general
question:
Find the approximate value of:

 (76.91 times 143.97)/(7.07 times 12.01) - frac{3.93² times sqrt{195.88}}{6.93 times 8.03⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} = ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Round all decimals to nearest integers: 77, 144, 7, 12, 4, 14, 7, and 2. First term: (77 × 144) ÷ (7 × 12) = 11 × 12 = 132. Second term: (4² × 14) ÷ (7 × 2) = (16 × 14) ÷ 14 = 16. Result = 132 − 16 = 116. **∴ The correct answer is 116.**
